items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: The famous two. Me, Badlacks, Lewis Givens, Poire.

ctx.x: The famous two. Me, Badlacks, Lewis Givens, Poire. Went there two nights a week. See, them boys was playing there, you know. And Smiley and Joe and Thed O, they were playing one night, you see. I mean, they were playing there all the week. Monday night, the white band would be off. And Sunday night, Thed O and them would be off with Badlacks. I played there them two nights. Played there for about a year.
